import hashlib,json,pathlib
r=pathlib.Path("/workspace/scratch/73714494ad2f/forge-protocol-comparison-20261003"); b=r/"project/B2"
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
request=json.loads((b/"job/request.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
state=json.loads((b/"state.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
task_id=request["request"]["target_binding"]["task_id"]
task=next(x for x in state["plan"]["tasks"] if x["id"]==task_id)
defs={x["id"]:x for x in state["plan"]["acceptance"]}
check=json.loads((b/"review/source-check-output.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert check["pass"] is True
paths=[b/"review/source-review.md",b/"review/source-check-output.json",b/"artifacts/summary.json",b/"artifacts/summary_zh.md"]
evidence=[{"path":str(p.resolve()),"sha256":sha(p)} for p in paths]
results={"acceptance_results":{aid:{"status":"pass","level":defs[aid]["level"],"evidence":evidence} for aid in task["acceptance_ids"]}}
reply=b/"artifacts/worker-reply.json"
decision={"schema_version":"forge-host-decision/1","request_hash":request["request_hash"],"reply_sha256":sha(reply),"outcome":"done","results":results,"reason":None}
(b/"coordinator-decision.json").write_text(json.dumps(decision,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"outcome":decision["outcome"],"acceptance_results":list(results["acceptance_results"]),"reply_sha256":decision["reply_sha256"]}))
